name: Crispy Spiced Chickpeas
description: Crunchy roasted chickpeas to nibble with drinks or scatter over salads.
recipeIngredient: 2 x 400 g tins chickpeas, drained and patted very dry

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the chickpeas with the oil on a large baking tray and roast for 20 minutes.
Mix the spices and salt, sprinkle over the chickpeas, shake the tray and roast for 10 minutes more until crisp.
Cool on the tray; they crisp up further as they cool.
